'''Jayke Ball'''<ref name="dt-13245">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13245 Ahhh  Harvest time again], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 28 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13245/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13245/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018063218/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13245/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Lord_vader20''') posted a [[Light]] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] list on DeckTech in January 2001.
